springtime.name: The Springtime of Nations
springtime.text: The Springtime of Nations. Revolution sweeps the continent; unrest soars everywhere.

famine.name: The Great Famine
famine.text: The Great Famine devastates {province}: {pop|inv|frac} of its people die or emigrate.

railway.name: Railway mania
railway.text: Railway mania: for {lasts|span}, factories cost {cost|down} less.

panic.name: The Panic
panic.text: The Panic. Banks fail across Europe: every nation loses {gold|inv|frac} its gold and earns {earns|inv|frac} less for {seasons|years}.

compromise.name: The Compromise
compromise.text: The Compromise: {nation} becomes a dual monarchy, and Hungary is calmed.

serfdom.name: The serfs are freed
serfdom.text: {nation} frees the serfs; workers pour into the factories of Moscow and St Petersburg.

incident.name: Border incident
incident.text: A border incident sours relations between {a} and {b}.

harvest.name: Failed harvest
harvest.text: A failed harvest brings bread riots to {nation}.

shevchenko.name: Ukrainian national awakening
shevchenko.text: Shevchenko's poems spark a Ukrainian national awakening; unrest grows in Ukrainian lands.

awakening.name: National awakening
awakening.text: A national awakening stirs the {people} people; their provinces grow restless.

revolution.name: Military revolution
revolution.text: Military revolution. {era}: every war forecast in Europe shifts.

boom.name: Boom
boom.text: {find} in {province} ({nation}): {factories|word} factories' worth of industry overnight.

ultimatum.name: Ultimatum
ultimatum.rattleText: {a} rattles its sabre at {b} over {pretext}, then thinks better of it.
ultimatum.text: Crisis. {a} sends {b} an ultimatum. {b} backs down, humiliated, and pays {gold} gold.
ultimatum.warText: Crisis. {a} sends {b} an ultimatum over {province}. {b} refuses, and the {war} begins.

greatWar.name: The Great War
greatWar.text: The lamps go out all over Europe. A shot in the Balkans sets the alliances in motion: {a} and {b} go to war. The Great War begins.

armistice.name: The Armistice
armistice.text: Armistice. At the eleventh hour the guns fall silent; peace is made on the lines as they stand.

opening.name: Europe
opening.text: Europe, {rules.start}. {count|Word} nations, each with its own ambition for the day the guns of the coming great war fall silent: to be the richest great power, to unite its people, or just to survive.
